spans.text: Bang-bang-bang...
The fierce exchange of gunfire interrupts the tranquility of the residential area.
The vehicle carrying the Commander speeds away on the deserted streets.
But as their location is exposed, more and more enemy reinforcements rush to intercept them.
There are too many pursuers! At this rate, the vehicle is going to fall apart very soon!
Focus on driving. I'll take care of the pursuers.
Clatter. M16 pulls open the sunroof and props her weapon up to fire at their relentless enemies.
416, cover me.
Got it. I'll keep an eye on what's behind you.
Bam!
A garrison soldier is hit by the vehicle. While it brakes for a brief second, 416 snatches the communicator out of the soldier's hand and hacks into it.
Can you find out their positions with this?
Yes.
A moment later, 416 has the answer.
Commander, they have soldiers blocking all exits in the White Zone.
More than a dozen teams are also searching along the main road...
Then we can't go back the way we came.
What should we do, Commander?
Do you have a topographic map of the White Zone?
We've got to make a break for it. We're just sitting ducks here and they'll get to us sooner or later.
Bang-bang-bang!
Another burst of bullets are fired at the vehicle. UMP45 swerves just in time to evade most of them.
You need a very high clearance level to access any map of the White Zone, and the topographic one is pretty much top secret.
I'm afraid we can't get to it on our own.
Nele, who has been nervously watching the gunfight through the window, suddenly speaks up.
I have a rough understanding of the geography here. I took the effort to memorize it because the Instructor asked me to.
Nele...
The urban planning here is very systematic, with different areas for different functions.
The center is the administrative area, which is roughly northwest from here, and there are residential areas in both the southwest and northeast.
We are currently in the southwestern one.
The Commander studies the diagram that Nele has quickly sketched and ponders their next move.
Do you know how we can get to the Main from here?
The Main... Why do you ask?
There is a circular Wiesbaden metro line that passes over the White Zone, and that's where the Main and the White Zone intersect.
...You clearly did your homework.
Still, we can't get out even if we find the intersection...
No...
What 16 means is that the walls where the metro line passes over the White Zone are weaker.
We can blast our way through there.
Indeed.
...I understand.
Nele stares at her own diagram with a frown.
Based on the information I have, I can only infer that the intersection is roughly to the north of the residential area, where the garrison base and the administrative area meet.
That is the water treatment facility, which is directly connected to the top of the White Zone.
Are you certain that this information is correct? It will directly determine our decision of where to go from here.
I'm fairly confident, unless the building is camouflaged.
That wouldn't be a problem.
We can run a soil analysis before we do it.
Then I have no other questions, Commander.
Thank you, Nele.
The Commander looks at the "X" that Nele has marked on the map and frowns.
We will have to get past the garrison base to get there. There's a chance that we'll be spotted.
The garrison has fully mobilized to hunt us down, so only a small number of soldiers are left behind at the base.
I'm more concerned about the comms network within the garrison. They respond to developing situations very quickly and their reinforcements  are very fast.
The moment they come across our tracks, they will immediately know where we're headed.
Don't worry, we will do everything we can to buy you time.
The explosion will also serve as a distraction to split the garrison's attention.
Right, then our current objective is to reach the water treatment facility.
Roger that.
UMP45 changes direction and speeds toward their new destination...
Bang-bang-bang!
416 shoots down the last approaching garrison soldier.
Just as M16 has surmised, the entire garrison has mobilized, leaving only a few squads at the camp.
416 looks up at the top section of the water treatment facility. If all has gone according to plan, M16 should have arrived at her position by now.
M16, 404 has finished cleaning up the scene.
But we couldn't sabotage the garrison's internal alarm system in time, so reinforcements are already on the way.
Copy that. I'm already on the top floor and setting the charges.
Give me five more minutes.
Acknowledged.
416 looks over at the vehicle in the parking lot nearby in which the Commander, Nele, and J are hiding.
UMP45 and UMP9 are already in position to protect the Commander.
All that's left to do is for her and Gr G11 to intercept any enemy reinforcements and stall them until M16 completes the detonation.
In this quiet moment just before the storm, 416 is suddenly plagued by an inexplicable sense of unease.
As if to prove her sense of premonition, a shrill alarm sounds from the water treatment facility.
Take cover. The charges are set.
Copy that. Retreat post-haste.
416 gestures to her teammates behind her to take cover and promptly runs to safety herself.
The Commander's vehicle is just a few steps away.
Boom!
The sound of a massive explosion comes from behind.
But there is no sign of the expected smell of smoke and burning.
When 416 opens her eyes again, she is no longer near the water treatment facility that should've been ablaze. Instead...
She finds herself in her own Level II space.
What's going on?
45? Is this you?
What's wrong? Why are you calling me via a Level II channel?
I got yanked into my Level II.
You got hacked?
I'm not sure.
Describe what you see.
416 takes in the starkly white space and looks for anything unusual.
Hiss...
The sound of a snake flicking its tongue.
It sounds extremely close, like it is right by her ear.
A snake...
I see a snake.
A snake?
416, we are now looking at your Level II through 45's shared screen.
We're not seeing this snake of yours.
416 stares unblinkingly at the white-lipped python coiled over several white objects that appear to be eggs.
It flicks its tongue at 416 in warning.
But 416 takes no notice at all. Her attention is on the egg-shaped objects guarded by the python.
There are protected data within those shells.
416 realizes what she is looking at.
This is "Cocoon".
45, what's the situation out there?
The explosion was a bit more powerful than we expected, but we've opened up a passage alright.
We are now repelling the garrison reinforcements while planning a route for the Commander.
Your frame should be near the Commander's vehicle.
If you have a plan, you'd better tell me now.
Honestly, things aren't looking very good here.
45, if there is a trap in front of you, and you know that taking the bait will kill you, but there is something vital in the trap, what would you do?
We are all desperados here. Since when are we scared of a little gamble?
I knew it...
416 lets out a sigh.
Even if I don't step in the trap now, you'll do it sooner or later.
Clatter. 416 raises her gun and walks up to the snake.
Then it'd better be me. Such things should be left to the squad leader, don't you think?
If I don't come back, you can take over as squad leader for a while.
416, there is always a chance that you'll lose everything in the gamble, so make sure you think it through.
I have thought it through.
416 deactivates her comms channel. The white-lipped python in front of her rears up, showing off its robust body and bearing its sharp fangs.
Commander... Never thought there'd come a day when I risk it all.
Bang-bang-bang!
416 squeezes her trigger, and the burst of bullets force the python to lean back.
The bullets bounce off its scales, creating a few sparks.
Tsk, that's some ridiculously strong defense. I bet its attack is equally—
Bam!
The white-lipped python whips its tail with lighting speed and the force of a tsunami.
Unable to dodge out of the way in time, 416 is brutally sent flying and crashes to the ground.
Why are the enemies all so overpowered these days?
With that kind of attack and defense stats, in Gr G11's words, this boss needs to be nerfed.
With a derisive snicker, 416 stumbles to her feet and faces off the python once more.
It raises its head high and flick its tongue as if in mockery.
416 recalls its previous attack and tries to identify any possible openings.
Boom! The python launches another attack.
...Pulling the same move?
416 slides through the gap between the python's tail and the ground. At the same time—
Bang-bang-bang!
She opens fire in the direction of its head.
I won't fall for the same trick twice!
The bullets once again bounce off its scales harmlessly with only a spark.
But causing damage is not 416's intention anyway. Her target has always been the "cocoon".
While the python is momentarily distracted, 416 grabs hold of one of the "cocoons".
Then...
Hiss...
She has lost sight of the snake, but the hiss by her ear is unmistakably clear.
Crunch...
The pain of being strangled.
She can't think. She can't move.
It feels as if she's being swallowed by the snake, paralyzed by deadly venom, and pushed further and further into hell.
Even so, 416 does not let go of the "cocoon" in her hand.
Bang-bang-bang! Boom!
The cacophony of gunfire pulls her back into reality.
...That's it?
416, answer me!
I'm here.
I got out.
Are you okay? You gave me quite a scare...
I'm fine. I'll go pick up the Commander.
I have important information for them.
Are you sure you're okay? 45 said you saw a snake or something...?
Yeah, we'll talk about that later.
I'll check up on the Commander first.
The white-lipped python sheds its skin, and a woman emerges gracefully.
She pulls up 416's real-time view.
...What a headstrong child. So eager to prove herself.
Do you honestly think you can leave unscathed after stealing Hydra's treasure?
Behind her, the remaining "cocoons" emit a faint glow.
Now let's see to whom you will offer the treasure.
Bang-bang-bang!
Rumble...
The fierce sound of battle seems to be fading into the distance.
The Commander wants to open their eyes, but their body refuses to obey.
Commander!
They feel an intense pain on their back and the side of their thigh, caused by some kind of strong impact.
The Commander remembers running into Task Force DEFY, who came to rescue them, but their ride was knocked over by an explosion...
Commander, wake up!
A cold hand smacks them on the cheek lightly.
Commander!!!
They've really got to wake up now.
Finally!
It's me. Take my hand.
Okay...
Still feeling numb and disoriented, the Commander reaches out toward 416 in a daze.
Right, I've got you.
Now try to relax. I'm going to pull you out of the car.
Sure...
Although the Commander is still too confused to understand the current situation, they still implicitly and wholeheartedly trust 416.
Here I go.
This may hurt, but don't worry, I'll get you out of here safely!
Right.
Whoosh!
This way, Commander!
Dragging the stumbling Commander along, 416 runs toward another vehicle that UMP45 has hacked.
...What about the others?
...Miss Nele and the funkily-dressed Dandelion are safe.
DEFY has also made it here and is currently drawing some of the fire from us and buying us time.
It's very reassuring to have you all around...
After helping the Commander into the vehicle, 416 closes the door and stands guard outside.
Commander, I'll stand guard out here.
Stay put inside the car for now. Once M16 is done clearing up a route, she'll come and give us a hand.
Okay.
45, is the Commander's escape route confirmed?
Basically yes. M16 is cleaning up the last obstacles.
How are things on your end?
We're safe for now.
Hiss...
There comes the persistent sound again.
416 senses the menacing breath by her ear.
Yes?
Come take over for me and watch the Commander.
Why? Where are you going?
Hiss...
416 feels ice-cold skin gliding over her frame, wrapping around her, but she sees nothing.
The bind constricts little by little, suffocating her more and more.
416, are you okay?
What's that thing in your eye? It's glowing faintly...
I'm okay, Commander.
She feels a burning sensation in both her right eye and where she was bitten on the arm.
She grips her gun tightly and forces her mind to focus.
416, come in.
Is this my punishment for losing the gamble?
I stole something important without paying my due...
...This is what I extracted from the Bee Sting System...
It's all in your hands, Commander. We will prevail.
In the dead silence, 416's gun slips out of her hand and clatters to the ground.
Like an icicle breaking off from a glacier, she plunges straight into an endless abyss of darkness.
The Commander catches her frame before she falls, but they cannot catch her soul.
...In Paradeus' temporary plant.
Nemhran takes the communicator, which should not be ringing at the moment, from Ashley. It is Hebe.
...What happened?
Remember Badbsca's cocoon that you left in my safekeeping?
...That one was already broken...
The information contained within couldn't be cracked... That's why I left it with you.
I used it to set a trap.
...What do you mean?
The thief is now marked...
Fine.
It's going to be leaked sooner or later anyway.
But don't act without authorization next time.
...How can we win if we're always so passive?
...The game is already at a point where we can't afford to make any random moves.
Hebe, I hope you understand the difficulty of the task at hand.
Of course I understand. This is precisely why we can't just remain on the defensive.
We may only stand a chance of winning if we actually take a chance.
...Have you considered that our mission objective...
Isn't actually to win this current game?
